title.en: Align docs with the probe implementation
title.zh: 文档对齐 probe 实现与实测

intent.en: After probe landed, the four docs still carried pre-implementation wording: design.md used the Windows OCR sketch (with unimplemented fingerprint/hash), still recommended PrintWindow, still claimed confidence works as a threshold, recorded the wrong OS language set and --psm 7; reference.md still said four command groups and omitted probe's measured behaviour and the real --engine invocation; README lacked the perception row and had stale module counts; development.md had stale module/API/dep counts. Docs only, no behaviour change.
intent.zh: probe 落地后四份文档仍有实现前的旧说法：design.md 的 probe 输出样例还是 Windows OCR 草图（含未实现的 fingerprint/hash），取像仍推荐 PrintWindow，置信度仍说可直接当阈值，本机 OCR 语言集记错，--psm 写成 7；reference.md 仍写四组命令且未写 probe 的实测行为与 --engine 的真实调用方式；README 缺感知能力且模块计数过期；development.md 的模块/API/箭头计数过期。本次只改文档，不改行为。

acceptance: docs/design.md 的 probe 样例、退出码表、--psm、取像方式、置信度边界、OCR 语言集与实现一致
docs/reference.md 写明五组命令、probe 的实测行为（遮挡/最小化/壳窗口/量级）与 --engine 的真实调用方式
README.md 有感知能力行，模块计数与 receipt.json 一致
docs/development.md 的模块/API/箭头计数与 receipt.json 一致
tests/check-docs.ps1 通过，normify_validate 带 repoRoot 为 0 error
note: 四份文档与 probe 实现/实测对齐：design.md 换上真实 JSON 形状与退出码、修正被推翻的说法（PrintWindow 取像、conf 阈值、OCR 语言集、--psm、模型哈希/区域指纹未实现）、reference.md 补五组命令与实测行为、README 补感知行、development.md 更新计数。仅改文档，代码与行为未动。
